sets.title: Recognize
sets.description: Identify discourse markers by function, then choose between easily confused pairs
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите функцию дискурсивных маркеров и выберите между похожими маркерами

items.prompt: Addition: Проект дорогой. _____, он требует много времени.
items.promptEnglish: The project is expensive. Moreover, it requires a lot of time.
items.hint: Adding another negative point to the first.
items.explanation: Кроме того (moreover/besides) is an addition marker that piles on extra information in the same direction.

items.prompt: Contrast: Погода была ужасная. _____, концерт прошёл успешно.
items.promptEnglish: The weather was terrible. Nevertheless, the concert was a success.
items.hint: The outcome was unexpected given the bad weather.
items.explanation: Тем не менее (nevertheless) signals that the result contradicts what you would expect from the first statement.

items.prompt: Result: Все данные подтверждают эту теорию. _____, мы можем её принять.
items.promptEnglish: All data supports this theory. Therefore, we can accept it.
items.hint: Drawing a logical conclusion from evidence.
items.explanation: Следовательно (therefore/consequently) introduces a logical conclusion drawn from the preceding evidence.

items.prompt: Sequence: _____, нужно собрать материалы. Во-вторых, составить план.
items.promptEnglish: First, you need to gather materials. Second, make a plan.
items.hint: The first item in an enumerated list.
items.explanation: Во-первых (firstly) opens an ordered sequence. It pairs naturally with во-вторых, в-третьих, наконец.

items.prompt: Addition (emphatic): Она прекрасный врач. _____, она отличный преподаватель.
items.promptEnglish: She is an excellent doctor. What's more, she is an outstanding teacher.
items.explanation: Более того (moreover/what's more) adds an even stronger point, escalating from the first statement.
